mirror.title: Hoard is backing up {game}'s backups, not your save
mirror.body: It's syncing `{tracked}`, the folder the game copies your save into every few minutes. Your actual save looks like it's in `{suggested}`, right next to it.
mirror.cost: That folder is using {size} in the cloud, and it grows every time you play — each copy is new content, so nothing can be deduplicated.
mirror.archive_title: Frees the quota those versions use. They stay downloadable for 7 days.
dashboard.service_offline_banner: The sync service is offline — backups are paused until it comes back.
dashboard.service_offline_no_session: The sync service has no session, so backups are paused. Sign in again to hand it your account.
dashboard.service_offline_keyring: The sync service can't read your saved session — the system keyring didn't hand it over. Signing in again stores it under the service and fixes it for good.
dashboard.service_offline_keyring_missin: The sync service can't read your saved session: this machine has no system keyring running, so there's nothing to hand it over. Sign in again — Hoard will keep the session in its own protected file instead, and it will stay there.
dashboard.service_offline_keyring_locked: The sync service can't read your saved session — the system keyring isn't answering, usually because it's locked and waiting for a password nobody has typed. Unlock your login keyring, or sign in again to store the session where Hoard can always read it.
dashboard.service_offline_keyring_damage: The sync service can't read your saved session — the system keyring holds it but can't decrypt it any more. Sign in again: that replaces the damaged entry, and if the keyring refuses again Hoard keeps the session in its own protected file.
dashboard.service_offline_keyring_refuse: The sync service can't read your saved session — the system keyring refused to hand it over, because the unlock window was dismissed or a system rule doesn't authorise this program. Sign in again and Hoard keeps the session in its own protected file, where it can always read it.
dashboard.service_offline_expired: Your session expired, so backups are paused. Sign in again to resume.
dashboard.service_offline_unreachable: Hoard can't reach the sync service, so it doesn't know whether backups are still running. Usually a busy moment; if the notice stays, restart the service.
dashboard.max_manual_hint: Separate cap for the copies you asked for (and the safety copy taken before a restore). Empty = unlimited, so a game that autosaves can't push them out of the history.

library.backup_blocked_notify_body: {name} can't sync and has stopped retrying ({count} conflicts). Open Hoard to sort it out.
library.steam_cloud_note_title: Steam Cloud also syncs this game. Hoard still tracks it: Steam Cloud only covers the Steam copy, can be turned off per game, and keeps no history to roll back to.
library.backup_too_large_toast: Couldn't back up {name}: {size} is over your plan's {limit} per-save limit. Upgrade to Pro or trim the save folder.
library.backup_too_large_generic_toast: Couldn't upload {name}: the server refused it as too large (413). If it's your own server, check the reverse proxy's body-size limit.
library.backup_too_large_server_toast: Couldn't upload {name}: it's over your server's {limit} per-snapshot limit. Raise `max_snapshot_size_mb` in its config.toml and restart it.
library.backup_too_large_proxy_toast: Couldn't upload {name}: it was refused as too large — and not by Hoard. Something between this PC and your server (a reverse proxy or tunnel) has a body-size limit. nginx's default is 1 MB.
library.backup_trimmed_toast: Backed up {name}, but your plan wasn't big enough: {omitted} older saves ({size}) weren't uploaded. Upgrade to Pro to keep them all.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Tweak how Hoard behaves on this machine. Changes are saved as soon as you toggle them.
settings.mode_backup_desc: Uploads your saves to the cloud. Restoring is always manual — it never downloads on its own.
settings.mode_sync_desc: Play on one machine, continue on another. Automatic upload and download with conflict protection.
settings.themes_desc: Choose how Hoard looks. Auto follows your system.
settings.accent_desc: Pick the colour of your gem.
settings.atmos_desc: How the background behind Hoard is painted.
settings.scale_desc: Make everything bigger or smaller. Ctrl + scroll wheel anywhere, Ctrl+0 to reset.
settings.scan_interval_hint: How often Hoard re-scans for newly installed games. Cheap — it reads no save data.
settings.backup_interval_hint: How often Hoard re-checks tracked saves for changes. The work is spread out over time to keep disk use low.
settings.conflict_retention_hint: Saved in ~/.local/share/hoard/conflicts/. Older copies are deleted automatically.
settings.data_saving_hint: Higher means fewer versions and longer gaps between snapshots, using less disk. Lower captures every change. Pinned versions and the latest one are always kept.
settings.auto_restore_label: Restore from cloud when a save folder is empty
settings.auto_restore_desc: When you add a tracked save and the local folder is missing or empty (fresh install, new machine), Hoard pulls the latest server snapshot in the background. Off by default — leave off unless you trust the agent to write into your home folder unattended.
settings.close_to_tray_desc: Closing the window keeps Hoard running in the background so backups continue. Quit from the tray icon to stop it.
settings.autostart_desc: Adds Hoard to your launcher. Pair with “Start minimised” for a quiet boot.
settings.start_minimised_desc: Launch with the window hidden — only the tray icon shows up.
settings.telemetry_desc: Help us see how many people are using Hoard. We only count events (successful backup, restore, first-run completed) — never your username, game names, save paths, file contents, or tokens. Off by default.
settings.wrapple_telemetry_desc: Sends how long you play each game, per day, so Wrapple can show your real hours across all your devices. This is the only thing that feeds the recap: turn it off and Wrapple stops working — it will have nothing to show. Your hours keep being counted on this machine either way, so turning it back on brings your history with it. Separate from the setting above, and turning it off sends nothing at all.
settings.notify_success_desc: A small desktop notification when a backup uploads successfully.
settings.notify_failure_desc: Alerts you when a backup fails, even after retries.
settings.forget_server_desc: This connection (address + access token) is saved on your device and the OS keychain, so it's restored every time Hoard starts — even after a reinstall. Forget it to remove the saved credentials so Hoard stops trying to reach this server.
settings.forget_confirm_body: Hoard will delete the saved address and access token for {url}. Your snapshots on the server aren't touched — you can connect again later with the address and a token.
settings.service_autostart_no_stable_pat: The app itself will start at login, but the sync service can't: this AppImage runs from a temporary folder that's gone by the next login, and a stable copy of the engine couldn't be written either. Sync still runs whenever Hoard is open. To have it run without opening anything, install the core with: curl -fsSL https://hoard.services/install.sh | sh
settings.service_autostart_no_service_ma: The app itself will start at login, but the sync service can't: this machine has no user service manager to register it with. Sync still runs whenever Hoard is open — to have it run without opening anything, start hoardd under your own supervisor.
settings.autostart_rejected: The OS rejected the autostart change — try enabling autostart from your launcher settings.
settings.language_desc: Choose the language Hoard uses for menus, buttons, and messages.
settings.catalog_desc: Hoard auto-detects games using the Ludusavi catalog. We refresh it daily in the background — hit the button to pull the latest list now.
settings.view_logs_desc: Inspect the agent's activity log. Handy for bug reports.
settings.about_line_2: Your server, your data. Source code & docs at hoard.dev.
settings.about_catalog_credit: Save-path catalogue from PCGamingWiki via the Ludusavi manifest, licensed CC BY-NC-SA 3.0.

library.no_save_alert_aria: No save folder detected — click for details
library.no_save_alert_body: We detected {name} via Steam but couldn't find a save folder yet — either the game hasn't been launched on this machine, or it writes saves to a path that isn't in our catalog. Pick the folder manually and Hoard will track it from there.
library.untrack_confirm_body: Hoard will stop watching this folder. Snapshots already on the server stay intact — you can restore them later or wipe them from the History page.
library.delete_confirm_body: This wipes every snapshot of {name} from the server. Local files are left alone. The action cannot be undone. After deleting, the game can be re-scanned and added again from Library.
library.rename_modal_body: Choose a display name for this game. It's saved only on this device — the game's internal id and your backups don't change. Leave it empty to go back to the detected name.
library.manual_path_set: Hoard will remember the folder you picked for {name}.
library.ignore_body: {name} will stop appearing in this session.

library.ignore_blacklist_untracks: Also stops tracking {count} save(s) already tracked here (backups are kept).

history.choose_destination_description: Hoard doesn't know a save folder for this game on this machine yet. Pick a folder and we'll create it if it doesn't exist.
history.pick_destination_dialog_title: Choose a folder for the restored save
history.allow_config_hint: Files like graphics.ini or settings.cfg hold this machine's resolution and hardware. They are always backed up, but they aren't written back unless you ask.
history.allow_config_game_hint_off: This game's settings files are backed up, but not written back when restoring. Applies to all of its folders.
history.allow_config_game_hint_on: This game's settings files are written on every restore, automatic ones included. Applies to all of its folders.
history.allow_config_game_orphan: This game isn't tracked on this machine — it only exists in the cloud, so there's nowhere to store the choice. Link a local folder first.
history.preview_unavailable: This version doesn't store per-file hashes, so its changes can't be previewed.
history.preview_nothing: Nothing to write: the folder already matches this version.

account.title: Account
account.signin_subtitle: Sync your saves across devices. No setup, no server to run.
account.signin_hint: We open your browser so you can sign in with Google, GitHub, Discord or Apple.
errors.device_free_cap: Sorry — it's not you. Hoard's Free plan is a gift, and to keep giving it away we can't allow several accounts on the same device. Upgrade to Pro to add another account here.
account.session_expired: Your Hoard Cloud session expired. Sign in again.
account.feature_storage_body: Up to 100 GB on Pro, with forever version history.
account.feature_sync_body: Unlimited devices on Pro, no manual file shuffling.
account.feature_privacy_body: Export everything any time. Cancel and walk away with your saves.
account.selfhost_body: Hoard works just as well against a server you host yourself.
account.selfhost_data_title: Your saves are on your own disk
account.selfhost_data_body: There's nothing for us to export: every version lives in the data folder of the machine running your server. Back that folder up and you've backed up everything.
account.selfhost_cloud_body: You don't need it — your server does the job. It's there for the machines you can't reach from home, and it can run alongside the server you already have.
account.storage_purging: Freeing space — deleting your oldest save versions to stay under quota.
account.storage_full: Storage full — sync paused. Delete saves or upgrade to keep syncing.
account.storage_export_warning: You're over your quota and old save versions are being deleted. Download a copy of all your data now so nothing important is lost.
liberate.title: Free up space
liberate.intro: Some of your games take up more than your plan allows, so syncing has stopped. We recommend upgrading to Pro. You can also download your saves before they're archived.
liberate.load_error: Couldn't load your games. Check your connection and try again.
liberate.explain_archive: Continuing moves these games to the black box: the cloud copy is frozen for 7 days (you can still download it from Account), then it's deleted. Your local save is never touched. You can reactivate it from your Library within those 7 days — as long as it fits your plan by then, so upgrade to Pro or free that space some other way first.
liberate.fits: That fits your plan — syncing resumes.
liberate.still_over: Still {size} over. Tick more games or upgrade.
liberate.shared_with: Shares {size} with {names} — archive both to free it
liberate.hopeless: Even archiving every game leaves you over {limit}. Upgrading to Pro is the only way to keep syncing everything.
archived.banner_body: Its cloud copy is frozen and will be deleted on {date}. Reactivate it to reclaim the space and resume syncing — after that date it's gone for good.
account.storage_downgrade_pending: Your storage drops to {size} on {date} ({days} days left). You keep your current space until then — export your data or free up room before it shrinks.
account.data_section_body: Export every save you've ever uploaded as a single ZIP. It's built in the background — a download link appears here (and by email) when it's ready.
account.export_building: Building your export ZIP. This can take a minute — you can leave this page.

account.delete_modal_body: Your account, every save and every device link will be removed.
account.delete_modal_grace: We keep a copy for 30 days in case you change your mind. After that it's gone.

cloud_error.bandwidth_exceeded: Bandwidth limit reached ({limit} per {window}). Try again in {retry}.
cloud_error.storage_exceeded: Storage full — {used} of {limit} used. Free up space or upgrade your plan.
cloud_error.generic: Something went wrong talking to Hoard Cloud. Try again in a moment.
settings.cloud_poll_hint: How often Hoard polls the server for new save versions. Changes now arrive instantly via push, so this is just a backup check — default 60s. Shorter feels snappier; longer is gentler if you're on a slow network.
settings.live_activity_desc: Floating panel in the bottom-right that lists recent backups, restores and cloud pulls.
eye.title: Live status
notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.empty_hint: Important messages from your server and account will appear here.
activity.empty: Nothing yet — launch a game and you'll see it land here.
activity.backup_too_large: Couldn't upload {name}: {size} exceeds the {limit} per-save limit. Upgrade to Pro.
activity.backup_quota_full: Storage full ({used} of {limit}) — uploads paused until you free space.
activity.backup_trimmed: {name} trimmed: {count} old saves ({size}) weren't uploaded. Upgrade to Pro.
activity.backup_files_unreadable: {name}: {count} file(s) couldn't be read and were left out. {error}
activity.storage_purging: Deleting old saves to free room — upgrade to Pro to stop this.
activity.storage_full: Storage full: no more saves can be uploaded. Upgrade to Pro.
activity.storage_grace: Your storage is shrinking soon. Nothing has been deleted yet — check Account for the date.
tour.account_body: Your account status and the storage space you have available.
tour.dashboard_body: The status of each save, your latest backups and a quick look at your storage.
tour.library_body: This is where you add games and emulators. Hoard finds save paths automatically with the Ludusavi catalog; you choose what to sync.
tour.history_body: Every save keeps a history of versions. You can roll back to any earlier copy in a couple of clicks if something goes wrong.
tour.automatic_body: In automatic mode, Hoard works in the background and uploads your saves after each session — never while you're playing. It lives in the system tray.
tour.screen_body: An overlay you can open and edit inside the game itself, to take notes or capture moments without leaving. A Pro feature.
tour.wrapped_body: Your gaming stats wrapped up Spotify-style: hours, streaks and your titles of the year. A Pro feature.
tour.settings_body: Language, sync mode, notifications and your account. Everything is configurable here whenever you need it.
account_deleted.title: Account scheduled for deletion
account_deleted.body: This account is scheduled to be permanently deleted on {date}. Until then it's frozen — your saves are safe but won't sync.
account_deleted.body_no_date: This account is scheduled to be permanently deleted. Until then it's frozen — your saves are safe but won't sync.
account_deleted.hint: Reactivate to cancel the deletion and keep using Hoard Cloud.
manual.title: Manual track
manual.description_game: Track a game the scan missed. Name it and point at its save folder; backup, sync and restore work like any other.
manual.game_folder_hint: The folder where the game stores its saves.
manual.processes_hint_game: Optional — helps Hoard tell when you're playing. Leave empty to derive it from the name.
scan_folder.title: Scan folder
scan_folder.description: Pick a folder and Hoard looks for game saves inside it.
scan_folder.empty: No game saves found in this folder.
scan_folder.hint: Choose a folder to scan for saves inside it.
scan_folder.use_as_is: Use the chosen folder as it is:
scan_folder.belongs_to_other: Heads up: those saves belong to {name}.
pro_page.title: Hoard Pro
pro_page.subtitle: The overlay, your Wrapped and room for your whole library.
pro_page.checkout_note: Checkout opens at hoard.services in your browser. Nothing is charged from here.
pro_page.signin_note: Pro is tied to a Hoard Cloud account. Sign in first and the plan will show up here.
pro_page.trial_note: No card. When it ends the feature locks again and nothing is charged.
pro_page.current_pro: You're on Pro. Everything below is already unlocked.
pro_thanks.title: Thanks for supporting Hoard
pro_thanks.subtitle: Your subscription pays for the servers your saves live on. Here's what you just got:
pro_thanks.devices_body: Pair as many machines as you like. This one is yours even if you stop paying for Pro some day — the cap never drops again.
pro_thanks.storage_body: Fifty times the Free plan: your whole library, version history included.
pro_thanks.screen_body: Your custom in-game overlay, synced across your machines.
pro_thanks.footnote: The 100 GB and Hoard Screen come with the subscription: cancel and they stay behind. The devices don't — those are yours now.
pro_farewell.title: Sorry to see you go
pro_farewell.subtitle: Thanks for the time you spent supporting Hoard. Your saves are still safe — here's what changes.
pro_farewell.keep_body: You were Pro, so the device cap never drops again. That one doesn't expire.
pro_farewell.storage_body: You're storing {used} in the cloud right now.
pro_farewell.storage_body_on: You're storing {used} in the cloud right now. The cut takes effect on {date}; nothing is deleted before then.
pro_farewell.screen_body: Your in-game overlay stops being available. Its setup stays saved in case you come back.
pro_farewell.over_body: With {used} stored and {limit} from now on, you're {over} over. Pick what goes to the black box yourself, or stay on Pro and pick nothing.
pro_farewell.fits: Your {used} fit in {limit}, so you won't lose a save to space.
settings.motion_desc: How much cards lean and light up when you point at them. Zero turns it off.
overlay.empty: Nothing yet — start a game and it'll show up here.
settings.overlay_desc: A translucent panel over the game with Hoard's live log: game opened/closed, uploads and restores.
settings.overlay_hotkey_desc: Press the combination you want to open it with.
overlay.saves_empty: No saves tracked on this machine yet.
update_gate.required_body: Version {version} has been waiting to install for two days. It needs your permission because this install came from a system package — approve the prompt and Hoard picks up where it left off.
update_gate.installing_body: Swapping in the new version. This takes a few seconds — your saves are untouched.
update_gate.restart_body: Version {version} is installed and the sync service is already running it. Restart the window to catch up.
update_gate.privileges_hint: Your system will ask for permission to install it.
library.add_folder_aria: Add another folder for this game
library.slot_pick_title: Which folder of this game is it?
library.slot_pick_body: {path} will be backed up under {name}. The number is what pairs it with the same folder on your other machines, so pick the one it already has there.
library.slot_pick_cloud: In the cloud from another machine — pick this to sync them together
library.slot_clash_body: Hoard already backs up {current} for {name}. Is {chosen} where that folder moved to, or is it a second folder of the same game?
library.rename_error_conflict: Another folder of this game already uses that label.
library.renumber_taken: Number {n} is already another folder of this game.
library.rename_keeps_number: The number stays as it is — it is what pairs this folder across your machines.
